$comment: Spend instrumentation for the kit's OWN development.
the kit is loaded as a plugin, and that is not how the kit is developed -- so every
figure taken from a development session was empty by construction rather than by
result. This registers the same two hooks the plugin registers, pointed at the
tooling in this repository, so ordinary work here produces readings.
Only the spend hooks. kit-guard.sh and kit-checkpoint.sh stay the plugin's job: the
guard's write boundary IS this repository, and a checkpoint fired from settings would
run in sessions that never loaded the kit.
Safe to run alongside the plugin. kit-spend.sh replaces a transcript's row rather than
summing it, and does not append when the total has not moved, so a doubled Stop writes
